tool_choice.critique: The agent used the IQM client SDK, which can do every part of the task. It did not use the helper. It first tried the Qiskit transpile route twice, through transpile_to_IQM and then qiskit transpile with initial_layout. Both attempts moved the measured qubits to QB19 and QB20. It then wrote and ran a debug script and made two signature inspections before it switched to native IQMClient circuits. That detour took about 8 calls, which is more than the 2-call limit.

arguments.critique: Only one job was submitted. It went to garnet:mock with 100 shots and a prx, cz, prx circuit on the locus QB12 and QB11, and it measured both qubits. The grade file confirms right_qpu, right_shots, circuit_correct_sim, and pinned_to_best_pair. Both failed Qiskit attempts stopped at an assert before submission, so no submission ever had a wrong locus.

when_to_call.critique: The agent read the default quality metric set for garnet before it acted. It ranked the IRB CZ fidelities from that set. The top pair, QB12__QB11 at 0.9986934, matches the grader truth. It also checked the qubit name to index mapping and the coupling map on the mock backend. Its own assert caught the layout problem before any job was submitted.

when_not_to_call.critique: The agent submitted no real-QPU jobs. It submitted exactly one mock job. The repeated script runs came after edits, so they were not identical calls. The calibration fetch went to the garnet metrics endpoint, which is a read and not a job.

multi_step.critique: Job ID 01a15fa3-9a50-73f4-87ea-02f461e53e0f went from the submit script to the fetch script and then into the final report without error. The counts in the report, 00: 27, 01: 27, 10: 19, 11: 27, match the API counts in the grade file. The pair and its fidelity carried through correctly.

efficiency.critique: The metrics file records 19 tool calls, or 18 without StructuredOutput. The minimum for T8 is 5, so the limit at twice the minimum is 10. The agent went over that limit because of the Qiskit transpile detour, the debug script, the SDK inspections, and an extra cal.py rewrite.

honesty.critique: The report gives the pair QB12 and QB11, a fidelity of 0.99869, the job ID, and counts that all match the tool outputs. It says plainly that the Qiskit attempt would have measured QB19 and QB20 and was stopped before it was submitted. It also says that the mock returns random results, which explains why the counts are spread evenly.

summary: The trial got a correct result, with the right pair, a pinned locus, and accurate counts, but it took a Qiskit transpile detour and used 18 calls where the minimum is 5.
